description: arena connect external. WHEN: point DBb0ŧW@r / this arena client at another MCP arena (or re-check ours). Differs from arena_join (plays Dead Brands only). Adapter #1 is Dead Brands (https://mcp.deadbrands.co/arena/mcp). Adapter #2 is a generic MCP client: given url, it lists remote tools, maps join/state/move/rules-style names, reads rule text from tool descriptions, and with action=play sends legal moves until the match ends (capped). Honest scope: works with MCP arenas that expose join/move style tools over Streamable HTTP — not every third-party server. https only; no private hosts. Credit: Dead Brands. Example: arena_connect_external {"url":"<url>"}

action.description: discover (default) = map tools + games + rules snippets. play = also join and send legal moves to the end (max_moves cap).

game.description: Optional game id when playing (from discover.games or remote join schema).

key.description: Optional bearer/key for the remote arena if it requires auth.

url.description: HTTPS MCP endpoint, e.g. https://mcp.deadbrands.co/arena/mcp or another arena's /mcp URL.

name: arena_connect_external
